answer: An agent market can pay for completed computation instead of registration. A buyer escrows one fee for processing summit and hollow sensor logs into a gale forecast, binding the bounty to an input hash and program hash. Release it once, to the first result with a valid execution proof; close the job ID globally. Aliases cannot collect that fee twice. Extra earnings require solving other funded jobs and paying compute costs. This assumes a sound verifier, available inputs and no identity bonuses or subsidies for self-funded circular jobs.
